comments.text: Zoomer here. You hit the nail on the head, this stuff has been observable throughout my entire life, and I'm so tired. The education system is beyond a mess -- going through it showed me that much -- and homeschoolers are generally among the more intelligent people I've met. Had my parents not cared much about me and just sent me to school with no other involvement, I'd probably be brainwashed, have no confidence/self-esteem, and be completely miserable. I can count on one hand the amount of my friends who are in a relationship, and its far fewer if you're just looking at the stable ones. Half the girls are looking for a quick hookup and the other half are single mothers looking for a father figure for their children. The best luck I've had in recent times was by just sitting next to a girl at church and talking to her, which at least got me a few good dates even if it didn't work out. Despite this, there is zero direction in my life. Over the past 6 years, I've been laid off, quit multiple jobs due to promotions without raises, and in between job hopping, I only make about 2 dollars more than I did starting out in the labor force. I have a steady job and still live with my parents, out of bare necessity. I sustain myself on one meal a day, with one day being a fasting day. Most people I speak to on a daily basis find humor in talking down to me, and that's about all they'd like to do in terms of engaging, outside of long term friendships, of course.
